items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dorothy told Manford we’ll have to make this record in California, and Manford’s not about to come to California. ... So we started producing our own records from then on.

ctx.x: And Manford had a big problem. [Imitates melody of Fish Out Of Water]. He had a problem with my flute playin’. And then over the years people loved my flute playin’, and now he says, “Oh, that’s great flute.” You know, but he has to educate himself.
